_doc: Seed + config for X (Twitter) discovery. X has NO free API (Nitter/snscrape dead), so this surface is read BROWSER-ASSISTED (Claude in Chrome, Brian's session) on demand - not by the unattended cron. The scan extracts tools/projects/releases/links, dedupes against discovery-seen, adds the good ones to the discovery report, AND proposes NEW proven accounts (deep cuts) found via who the trusted set amplifies. Many of these people ALSO blog - those RSS feeds are in currency_watch.json blog_feeds and get pulled automatically. See X_DISCOVERY.md.
_source: Merged from Brian's own 'Learn from the AI GOATS' pack (people-to-follow.md / creators.csv) + a 2026 best-of scan. Handles inferred from names - verify on first scan. Add your_handle + any Lists.
